title: Lalibela Cultural Tour
description: Discover the incredible rock-hewn churches of Lalibela, experience Ethiopian culture, and explore one of the country's most remarkable historical destinations with a local guide.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lalibela
itinerary.description: Meet your guide, settle into your accommodation, and explore the local area.

itinerary.title: Explore the Rock-Hewn Churches
itinerary.description: Visit Lalibela's famous churches and learn about their history and cultural significance.

itinerary.title: Local Culture and Departure
itinerary.description: Experience local traditions, enjoy the surrounding scenery, and conclude your tour.

title: Lalibela Guided Adventure
description: Enjoy a guided adventure around Lalibela, discover historical landmarks, and experience the beauty of the surrounding landscape.

itinerary.title: Discover Lalibela
itinerary.description: Explore important historical sites with your local guide.

itinerary.title: Culture and Scenery
itinerary.description: Experience local culture and enjoy the surrounding landscape.

title: Simien Mountain Trek
description: Explore spectacular mountain scenery, hike scenic trails, and discover the unique wildlife of the Simien Mountains.

itinerary.title: Arrival and Preparation
itinerary.description: Meet your guide and prepare for your mountain adventure.

itinerary.title: Begin the Trek
itinerary.description: Explore mountain trails and enjoy breathtaking views.

itinerary.title: Mountain Exploration
itinerary.description: Discover scenic viewpoints and look for native wildlife.

itinerary.title: Explore the Highlands
itinerary.description: Continue your trek through the dramatic mountain landscape.

itinerary.title: Return Journey
itinerary.description: Complete the trek and return from the mountains.

title: Gondar Heritage Tour
description: Explore Gondar's historic castles, discover royal architecture, and learn about Ethiopia's fascinating imperial past.

itinerary.title: Royal Gondar
itinerary.description: Explore historic royal sites and learn about Gondar's history.

itinerary.title: Heritage and Culture
itinerary.description: Discover more historic landmarks and experience local culture.

title: Harar Cultural Tour
description: Discover the historic walled city of Harar, explore its colorful markets and traditional Harari homes, visit important cultural landmarks, and experience the unique traditions of eastern Ethiopia with a local guide.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Harar
itinerary.description: Meet your local guide, settle into your accommodation, and explore Harar's historic streets and vibrant markets.

itinerary.title: Explore the Old Walled City
itinerary.description: Discover Harar Jugol, visit historic mosques and traditional Harari houses, explore local markets, and learn about the city's rich cultural heritage.

itinerary.title: Harari Traditions and Departure
itinerary.description: Experience local food and coffee traditions, discover more of Harar's cultural landmarks, and conclude your tour.

includes: Visits to historical and cultural landmarks
